craftEvidence.value: The prior public production export exposed createAgentSemanticDispositionReviewHostGatewayV2, so any Main-shaped caller could register an arbitrary invoke callback returning locally constructed pass JSON; canonical hashes only proved self-consistency and the live WeakMap registration then made that fake execution appear authoritative. WeakMap authority is keyed by process-local object identity and is empty after serialization/restart/fresh import, so it cannot back a durable recovery claim. The prior EvidenceEntry/snapshot/ProjectContextRef/witness/FactQuery constructors verified that caller objects agreed with one another, but no approved producer or frozen-store load attested their provenance, so a caller could fabricate the entire consistent graph. The smallest durable trust root is a Main-pinned public policy containing an Ed25519 public key, approved reviewer-load hash, and evidence-store id/config hash; the host Agent alone holds the private key, performs the real reviewer invocation and authoritative store loads, and signs the complete execution plus load receipts. Main only rehydrates and verifies against its pinned policy. Standard Node Ed25519 is used only because cross-process non-mintability requires detached authenticity; Core supplies no provider runtime and does not claim a real model ran. Downstream Agent owns private-key custody, real reviewer/load adapters and attestation production; downstream Main owns trusted-policy loading, durable JSON persistence and verifier invocation.
